name: Windeck (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of blue, white and blue in the proportions 1:4:1, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Windeck (a red lion on white above an armoured figure on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Windeck; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Windeck arms — lion and armoured figure
